description: This source file contains the class implementation for the Address controller within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically handling customer address functionalities such as listing, editing, and form handling.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class managing customer address related actions such as listing, editing, and saving addresses in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the default address page, loading language, checking customer login status, setting breadcrumbs, and rendering the address view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of customer addresses, constructing breadcrumb navigation, and handling redirection if the customer is not logged in.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: A protected method that fetches addresses from the model and formats them for display.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the address form for adding or editing a customer address, initializes form data, handles loading existing address info if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving customer address data, either creating new or updating existing entries, and sets session tokens for upload functionality.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Fetches details of a particular address to pre-fill the form when editing.
